summary: Pacific Oak Strategic Opportunity REIT (via its BVI subsidiary) obtained Israeli court approval for a debt arrangement restructuring Series B and D bonds. The arrangement amends trust deeds covering maturity, interest, security, and enforcement. No specific financial terms (price, premium) or advisory roles are disclosed. The restructuring is under the Israeli Insolvency Law, with bondholder approval already obtained. Completion is conditional upon closing conditions; the company will provide further updates. For US investors, this is akin to a court-supervised debt restructuring. Watch for implementation timeline and any subsequent filings detailing revised bond terms and potential impairment.
